name: Miina
source:
A very Bright and Innocent girl Ayumi meet in the "Mansion of the Stopped Time".
She often calls herself 'Captain Miina'.
She seems to want to "Play Together" in the "Mansion of the Stopped Time".

"Okay~! Let's March forward with Captain Miina~!"

[From the [url=https://www.lumpofsugar.co.jp/product/yumahorome/#modal]official website[/url]]
